The '''Incorporation Islands Tram Station''' was a tram station that was part of the [[Coronet Junction]], a [[rocket tram]] system that ran throughout [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The station was the station for the [[Incorporation Islands]] region of the [[City/Legends|city]], and was located in the [[Corporate Arrivals Plaza]].<ref name="TOR" />
